sources.citation: Suryawanshi, Ramesh Sitaram. 2014. Ahirani boli: vyakaran tatha bhashavaidnyanik abhyas. Kannad (Aurangabad): Abhyasika. 182 pp. In Marathi (archive.org rss221718_yahoo_9).
sources.note: No stress section; a full-text search for stress/accent आघात/स्वराघात/बलाघात empty. p. 17: 'स्वरांची दीर्घता मराठीप्रमाणे स्वनिमिक नाही.. एकावयवी शब्दांती स्वर नेहमीच दीर्घ असतात. बहुअवयवी शब्दांमध्ये शेवटच्या अवयवातील स्वर दीर्घ असतो' (vowel length non-phonemic; final-syllable vowel long) -- length, not stress.

sources.citation: Suryawanshi, Ramesh Sitaram. 2013 [1st ed. 1997]. Ahirani Boli Shabdkosh (Ahirani-Marathi). Kannad (Aurangabad): Abhyasika. Linguistic introduction ('prastavana'), printed pp. 8-63. In Marathi. archive.org item 5Prast03.
sources.note: Nothing. pp. 32-36 give vowel system (length non-phonemic, depends on syllable shape), consonant chart, vowel sequences, syllable structure; no aaghaat/stress/accent remark. p. 41 cites Vijaya Chitnis's thesis.

sources.citation: Sindkhedkar, S. D. 2010 (hdl:10603/91969) and Chaudhari, S. S. 2009 (hdl:10603/676836): remaining chapters not yet scanned (only ch. 3 phonology sections were read).
sources.note: other chapters could contain a prosody remark, though the phonology sections proper are silent.

sources.citation: Sindkhedkar, Sushilkumar Dattatraya. 2010. Ahirani boli va loksahitya: ek bhashashastriya va samajbhashashastriya abhyas. PhD, Dr. B. A. Marathwada University, Aurangabad. In Marathi. hdl:10603/91969. Ch. 3 sec. 3.5 pp. 67-74.
sources.note: Sec. 3.5 'Ahiranichi svanim vyavastha': 7 vowel and 21 consonant phonemes with minimal pairs; nothing on stress.
